svg.aria-label: The 1553 Bayt Jala and 1562 Ramallah register names compared
svg.text: Every household head the Ottoman clerks wrote down at Bayt Jālā in 1553 and at Ramallah in 1562 — and the nineteen who appear in both, name and father alike.
the 36 Christian households the clerk calls al-Kasābra
63 Christian households and 8 bachelors, nine years later
at Ramallah, same name and same
1562 are the son of a Rāshid
✻ marks the bachelors. John Mogannam flags seven; the register’s own total is eight.
Transliterated by John Mogannam from Registers 289 and 516; query marks and alternative readings are his, and are kept.
